text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whooosh!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! I can't even see where that
landed, you
made it fly so far!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whatcha think? Nothing like a relaxing
afternoon
on the course, amirite?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. This is really good for
strengthening the
core, too! But I have
to say...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's amazing how far you were able to hit
that ball.
You must've practiced a lot to
get that good.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Thanks! Real talk though, I literally just got the hang of it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I don't even know why. I haven't gotten
any new
clubs or anything. Honestly, I've
spent more time
working with my trainer
than anything.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I have good core strength? Well, I have been golfing for a long time... Guess that's working out well for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hm, okay. If I do that, I bet I'll be able
to run
more smoothly...
choice_data_list: それを活かして、フォームを安定させよう
choice_data_list_en: Let's use that to stabilize your form.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I like the sound of that! I've so not been feeling my races lately. I just feel super tired and dull during the second half of them!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Next thing I know, Trainer's whipped up
a new
training regime just for me.
choice_data_list: もっとレースが楽しめるようになろう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's learn to enjoy racing even more!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: And get this... The whole schedule's not based on training theories or whatevs, but on my feelings and what I want.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, it's easier for me to hang
in there
and keep going. Heh! How's
that for makin'
strides?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So your trainer's boosting your
motivation by
maximizing on your
strengths, huh? Sounds like a
great
environment to be in. By the way...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Have you noticed how you've
basically
been gushing about your
trainer this entire time?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What? Me? Gushing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Omigosh, that? Nooo, I wasn't gushing at all! I was just pointing out how awesome my trainer is!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I dunno how to put it, but my trainer's
just super
special to me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, okay, that really does make it
sound like
I'm gushing. Welp! I guess
that's just how it is,
then!
